entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: A motorcycle-shaped Persona, huh...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You know, I can turn into a car too,[n]so it's like... I feel a sense of familiarity?
Motorcycles are cooler.
Maybe you're a Persona?
I get carsick...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You just don't get it. Don't underestimate[n]the power of four-wheel drive!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Uh, no. I'm supposed to be human!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You better not throw up in me!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, motorcycles are nice too, but it[n]can't carry large numbers of people.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I really am special after... all... huh?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Carry...? No... Take somewhere?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Something just crossed my mind...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...It's no use. I can't remember at all...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Eh. There's nothing I can do about it[n]if I can't remember.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I need to concentrate on Kaneshiro[n]for now.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Unlike you guys, Makoto's clever, so[n]we can expect great things from her.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But [fName], you really do have[n]something special.
It was a coincidence.
I just got lucky.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Looks like I better step up my game too!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I know! After we deal with Kaneshiro,[n]I should consult her about Mementos[n]too.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm sure Makoto's brain can—

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hellooooo...?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We got Yusuke, and now Makoto...[n]This guy has quite the luck...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Could there be some reason for it?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Nah, that can't be...
I feel like my bond with[n]Morgana is growing deeper...
